text: Kevin Travers, Lead Audit Engagement Partner, KPMG LLP and Maria Khoushnood, Audit Senior Manager and Project Manager, KPMG LLP will give a presentation on The City of Toronto Audit Findings Report for the Year Ended December 31, 2020.

Received the presentation (May 21, 2021) from Kevin Travers, Lead Audit Engagement Partner, KPMG LLP and Maria Khoushnood, Audit Senior Manager and Project Manager, KPMG LLP, headed "The City of Toronto Audit Findings Report for the Year Ended December 31, 2020", for information.
